title: Compute the difference in total view counts between posts owned by users wh
question: Compute the difference in total view counts between posts owned by users who awarded a bounty of 50 on any post titled with 'variance' and posts owned by users who received more than 10 negative comments (score < 60).

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.XCL_030), 0)
   FROM posts p
   WHERE p.XCL_033 IN (
     SELECT ph.XCL_017
     FROM postHistory ph
     JOIN posts p2 ON ph.XCL_014 = p2.XCL_026
     WHERE ph.XCL_013 = 10
       AND p2.XCL_035 LIKE '%variance%'
   ))
  -
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.XCL_030), 0)
   FROM posts p
   WHERE p.XCL_033 IN (
     SELECT c.XCL_010
     FROM comments c
     WHERE c.XCL_007 < 60
     GROUP BY c.XCL_010
     HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
   )) AS difference

    SELECT DISTINCT p.XCL_033 AS user_id
    FROM posts p
    JOIN votes v ON p.XCL_026 = v.XCL_067
    WHERE v.XCL_071 = 50
      AND p.XCL_032 LIKE '%variance%'
),
negative_comment_recipients AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_033 AS user_id
    FROM posts p
    JOIN comments c ON p.XCL_026 = c.XCL_006
    WHERE p.XCL_030 < 60
    GROUP BY p.XCL_033
    HAVING COUNT(c.XCL_005) > 10
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.XCL_039), 0) 
     FROM posts p 
     WHERE p.XCL_033 IN (SELECT user_id FROM bounty_awarders)) -
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.XCL_039), 0) 
     FROM posts p 
     WHERE p.XCL_033 IN (SELECT user_id FROM negative_comment_recipients)) AS difference

react.raw_react_sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.XCL_030), 0)
   FROM posts p
   WHERE p.XCL_033 IN (
     SELECT ph.XCL_017
     FROM postHistory ph
     JOIN posts p2 ON ph.XCL_014 = p2.XCL_026
     WHERE ph.XCL_013 = 10
       AND p2.XCL_035 LIKE '%variance%'
   ))
  -
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.XCL_030), 0)
   FROM posts p
   WHERE p.XCL_033 IN (
     SELECT c.XCL_010
     FROM comments c
     WHERE c.XCL_007 < 60
     GROUP BY c.XCL_010
     HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
   )) AS difference
